title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® Pathogen Protocol
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and deck
steps.instruction: Perform the lysis according to the NucleoMag® Pathogen user manual; fill the 12‑well buffer reservoir as indicated in the kit table; vortex‑resuspend the NucleoMag® B‑Beads and place them in Position A1 of the 2 mL tube rack; load the instrument deck according to the displayed positions; place the square‑well block containing the lysates on the magnetic module and start the run.

substeps.instruction: Perform the lysis according to the NucleoMag® Pathogen user manual.
Fill the 12‑well buffer reservoir according to the table provided with the kit.
Resuspend the NucleoMag® B‑Beads by vortexing and place them in Position A1 of the 2 mL tube rack.
Load the instrument deck according to the displayed positions.
Place the square‑well block containing the lysates on the magnetic module and start the run.

steps.title: Binding step
steps.instruction: Execute the binding step as defined in the NucleoMag Pathogen protocol.

steps.instruction: Perform Wash 1 as defined in the NucleoMag Pathogen protocol.

steps.instruction: Perform Wash 2 as defined in the NucleoMag Pathogen protocol.

steps.instruction: Upload custom labware JSON files to the OT App via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware, if needed.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware
steps.instruction: Calibrate labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for details).

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to start the automated NucleoMag Pathogen workflow.
